decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/	The proposal, by reason of the height and scale of the proposed turret, results in a visually obtrusive feature that would be an unsympathetic addition to and out of character with the existing house and surrounding area, detrimental to the street scene.  The proposal therefore fails to comply with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003, and Supplementary Planning Guidance (February 1997 and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines).  
2/	The proposal, by reason of its size, design and appearance, would result in a loss of amenity to the adjoining and neighbouring residential properties through unbalancing the appearance of the pair of semis and overlooking.  The development therefore fails to comply with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003, and Supplementary Planning Guidance (February 1997 and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines).
description: Erection of first and roof extension and demolition of existing single storey rear extension, erection of new single storey rear extension to existing house.
